reviews.body: Thanks for the fix, @Nayana-R-Gowda. LGTM — changing `overflow-hidden` to `overflow-auto` on both `login.html` and `change-password-required.html` is the correct fix. On smaller viewports or when the password requirements section expands, the form content was being clipped. Simple and targeted fix.

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
LGTM — clean, minimal fix.

**Bug:** `overflow-hidden` on `<body>` clips the login form when the viewport is smaller than the content (browser zoom, small screens, mobile on-screen keyboards), making the form unusable.

**Fix:** `overflow-auto` adds scrollbars only when content actually overflows — correct behavior for a login page.

**Verified:**
- Both `login.html` and `change-password-required.html` get the same fix — consistent
- Inner child divs retain their own `overflow-hidden` for clipping decorative elements (gradient blobs, SVG patterns) — unaffected
- No security or performance implications
- Rebased onto latest `main`, no conflicts

commits.message:
fix: replace overflow-hidden with overflow-auto on login pages

overflow-hidden prevented scrolling when the viewport became smaller
(e.g., page zoom). overflow-auto restores normal scrolling while
keeping layout styles intact.

Signed-off-by: NAYANAR <nayana.r7813@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
